PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/google-research__robel --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware run. The card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper express the interface: native robel.dclaw.pose:DClawPoseFixed is the card's AST entry symbol (robel/dclaw/pose.py:165), DClawPoseFixed-v0 is registered at robel/dclaw/__init__.py:26-29, and the bridge derives cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 from the Box(-1.0, 1.0) action space and the 27-value observation (9 qpos + 9 last_action + 9 qpos_error). No deviation from the card. The fake backend (fake.py) is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in because MuJoCo 2.1, mujoco-py, gym and numpy are not installed here and package code never imports the clone. It mirrors reset, step, seed, close and dt (G7 pass), uses the clone's action denormalization and qpos/qvel clipping, the pose reward, and a Python random.Random seeded reset; it does not model contacts, actuator forces, gear friction, damping, sensors, observation noise, rendering or the upstream numpy random stream. It also does not apply the registered 80-step TimeLimit that gym.make wraps around DClawPoseFixed-v0; an episode in the fake ends only on reset. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine and mujoco-py; any comparison of the fake with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gym.make after installing robel); rendering; the random and random-dynamics variants; snapshot and restore (the fake exposes no get_state/set_state, and upstream get_state covers only qpos/qvel); physical DClaw hardware and validation against it. Provenance note: the 50 ms control interval is 20 simulation steps of the 2.5 ms pose episode (robel/dclaw/pose.py:55 and robel/dclaw/__init__.py:24). The MJCF <option timestep="0.0025"> lives in the robel-scenes submodule, which is not a text file at the pinned commit, so no Fact cites it. Expected warnings (PLAYBOOK section 8): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs seed twice, ticks and action.values[*]. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was emitted. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
